tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and data pipeline optimization. I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into functional SAP Commerce solutions. Skilled in agile delivery, production troubleshooting, and AI-assisted development to drive high-performance, scalable e-commerce architectures.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Rehau Application Consultant SAP Commerce (mwd)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Application Consultant SAP Commerce role at REHAU. With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise-grade e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute my technical expertise and techno-functional approach to your digital commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211, designing and implementing complex backend functionality and OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into functional specifications and user stories, ensuring seamless alignment between stakeholders and development teams.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: I have successfully engineered and optimized data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring high data consistency across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Production & Performance
bullets.text: I bring deep experience in production troubleshooting, database query optimization, and CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 to maintain system stability and performance.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with REHAU's goals.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Rehau Application Consultant SAP Commerce (mwd)
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich als Application Consultant SAP Commerce bei REHAU. Durch meine über fünfjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte technische Expertise und eine ausgeprägte techno-funktionale Arbeitsweise mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende Erfahrung mit SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 und 2211, insbesondere bei der Implementierung von Backend-Funktionalitäten und OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT übersetze ich komplexe Anforderungen in präzise funktionale Spezifikationen und User Stories.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenflüsse
bullets.text: Ich habe erfolgreich Datenpipelines zwischen PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systemen konzipiert und optimiert, um eine konsistente Datenhaltung sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Produktionssupport
bullets.text: Durch meine Erfahrung in der Fehlerbehebung, Datenbankoptimierung und CI/CD-Prozessen auf CCv2 garantiere ich eine hohe Systemstabilität.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: REHAU is a global leader in polymer-based solutions, and I am impressed by your commitment to digital transformation and customer-centric e-commerce. My experience in managing complex PIM/ERP integrations and high-traffic e-commerce platforms aligns perfectly with your need for a consultant who understands both the technical architecture and the business requirements of a global enterprise.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by solving complex integration challenges and delivering high-performance e-commerce solutions that directly impact business success. I enjoy working in international teams and bridging the gap between technical implementation and business strategy.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell & Shell. I am currently looking for new challenges in Germany and would love to contribute to REHAU's e-commerce team. Are you open to a brief chat?
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Rehau Application Consultant SAP Commerce (mwd) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Application Consultant SAP Commerce position at REHAU. With over 5 years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211), Java, and complex system integrations, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team. I am based in Karlsruhe and available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing my application with you.

Best regards,

Kranti Chavan
